```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
DimPlot(ATAC)

Idents(ATAC) <- ATAC$new.ident

ATAC <- RenameIdents(ATAC,
             "2014_0102" = 'C1', 
             "2016_1853"	= 'C2', 
             "MF244_GNB"	= 'C3',
             "MF244_GNM"	= 'C4',
             "2018_4252" = 'C4',
             "2020_1288"	= 'C5', 
             "16_4503"	= 'M1',
        "2018_1404"	= 'M2', 
        "2019_5022"	= 'M3', 
       "2019_5754"	= 'M4',
        "2005_1702"	= 'A1', 
        "2016_3924"	= 'A2', 
       "2006_2684"	= 'S1',
        "2018_1625"	= 'S2', 
       "2018_6056"	= 'S3',
       "2019_2495"	= 'A3',
        "2020_1667"	= 'S5')

ATAC$sample <-Idents(ATAC) 
table(ATAC$sample)

ATAC$group <- NA
ATAC$group[grepl("A", ATAC$sample)] <- "ATRXmut"
ATAC$group[grepl("C", ATAC$sample)] <- "control"
ATAC$group[grepl("M", ATAC$sample)] <- "MYCNamp"
ATAC$group[grepl("S", ATAC$sample)] <- "ATRXwtMYCNwt"
ATAC$group <- as.factor(ATAC$group)

table(ATAC$group)

saveRDS(ATAC, file = paste0(params$out, "/Rds/fetahu2023_scATAC_data.Rds"))
```

```{r}
library(reshape2)
percent_group <- table(ATAC$cell_type,ATAC$group)

# remove NB cells
percent_group <- percent_group[-6,]

# Transform this data in %
data_percentage <- apply(percent_group, 2, 
                         function(x){x*100/sum(x,na.rm=T)})

percent_group_trans <- melt(data_percentage) 

barplot_groups <- ggplot(percent_group_trans, aes(x = Var2, 
                                                      y = value, 
                                                      fill = Var1)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  theme_void() + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Percentage of cells assigned to each cluster", 
       fill = "Clusters") +  
  ggtitle("snATAC-seq: Stacked barplot of cell types") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COLOR_CODE_ATAC)

barplot_groups

pdf(paste0(params$out,"figures/barplot_ATACseq_all_clusters_per_group.pdf"))
barplot_groups
dev.off()
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
set.seed(2805)

DensityScatter(NK_ATAC,
               x = 'nCount_peaks', 
               y = 'TSS.enrichment', 
               log_x = TRUE, 
               quantiles = TRUE)

VlnPlot(
  object = NK_ATAC,
  features = c('nCount_peaks', 
               'TSS.enrichment', 
               'blacklist_ratio', 
               'nucleosome_signal', 
               'pct_reads_in_peaks'),
  pt.size = 0.3,
  ncol = 5)

NK_ATAC <- subset(
  x = NK_ATAC,
  subset = nCount_peaks > 1500 &
    nCount_peaks < 30000 &
    pct_reads_in_peaks > 50 &
    blacklist_ratio < 0.002 &
    nucleosome_signal < 1.5 &
    TSS.enrichment > 2)


NK_ATAC <- RunTFIDF(NK_ATAC)
NK_ATAC <- FindTopFeatures(NK_ATAC, 
                          min.cutoff = '10')
NK_ATAC <- RunSVD(NK_ATAC)
DepthCor(NK_ATAC)

NK_ATAC <- RunUMAP(object = NK_ATAC, reduction = 'lsi', dims = 2:30)
NK_ATAC <- FindNeighbors(object = NK_ATAC, 
                         reduction = 'scOpen', 
                         dims = 2:30)
NK_ATAC <- FindClusters(object = NK_ATAC, 
                        verbose = FALSE, 
                        resolution = 0.2,
                        algorithm = 3)
DimPlot(object = NK_ATAC, 
        label = TRUE) + NoLegend()

table(NK_ATAC$seurat_clusters)
Idents(NK_ATAC) <- NK_ATAC$seurat_clusters

NK_ATAC <- subset(NK_ATAC, 
                  idents = c("0","1","2"))

DimPlot(object = NK_ATAC, 
        label = TRUE) + NoLegend()

NK_ATAC$seurat_clusters <- droplevels(NK_ATAC$seurat_clusters)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# there was an issue with the index of the fragment file
# so i loaded the original file and subset it to the NK cells only
# than loaded the subset file to the seurat object

library(data.table)

frag_file <-"/home/rstudio/mnt_out/snATAC-seq_stage_M/results/published/data/AGGR_ALL_ATAC/fragments.tsv.gz"
output_frag_file <- paste0(params$out,"Rds/feathu2023_ATAC_NKcells_fragments.tsv")

# Get the cell barcodes from the subsetted Seurat object
subset_barcodes <- colnames(NK_ATAC)

# Read the original fragment file, filter it, and write a new one
fragments <- fread(cmd = paste("zcat", frag_file), sep = "\t", header = FALSE)

# Ensure correct format: Fragment files should have 5 columns (chromosome, start, end, barcode, count)
colnames(fragments) <- c("chr", "start", "end", "barcode", "count")

# Filter for barcodes in the subsetted Seurat object
subset_fragments <- fragments[fragments$barcode %in% subset_barcodes]

# Write to a new gzipped fragment file
fwrite(subset_fragments, file = output_frag_file, sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
output_frag_file <- paste0(params$out,"Rds/feathu2023_ATAC_NKcells_fragments.tsv.gz")

fragments <- CreateFragmentObject(
  path = output_frag_file,
  cells = colnames(NK_ATAC))

NK_ATAC[['peaks']]@fragments <- list(fragments)
```

```{r}
# extrapolating RNA activity based on chromatin accessibility of the corresponding promoter regions
gene.activities <- GeneActivity(NK_ATAC)

# add the gene activity matrix to the Seurat object as a new assay and normalize it
NK_ATAC[['RNA']] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = gene.activities)
NK_ATAC <- NormalizeData(
  object = NK_ATAC,
  assay = 'RNA',
  normalization.method = 'LogNormalize',
  scale.factor = median(NK_ATAC$nCount_RNA)
)
```

# ___Differentially accessible peaks between NK sub-types___

```{r}
# change back to working with peaks instead of gene activities
DefaultAssay(NK_ATAC) <- 'peaks'

# wilcox is the default option for test.use
da_peaks_0vs1 <- FindMarkers(
  object = NK_ATAC,
  ident.1 = "0",
  ident.2 = "1",
  test.use = 'wilcox',
  min.pct = 0.1
)

head(da_peaks_0vs1)
```
